description: The corpus `examples` entry the gate:examples selftest injects (FE-2752 bdd B7). `codeFile` points at the sibling snippet.ts; the selftest reads it into the entry's `code`, clones the real corpus.json with this entry added, runs gate:examples, and asserts exit 1 naming the example id and the missing export in `expectFinding`. corpus.json is backed up and restored unconditionally.
title: FE-2752 negative control — snippet importing a non-existent export
